title: Variety records: fruit (e.g. banana, mango, citrus) (open sources)
context: fruit (e.g. banana, mango, citrus) are important crops with openly-documented varieties in gene banks and public catalogs.
objective: Compile documented variety records for fruit (e.g. banana, mango, citrus) from open sources, following the schema with a citation and license per record.
acceptanceCriteria: >=15 records across >=2 fruit (e.g. banana, mango, citrus), each with source + license
No proprietary catalogs or agronomic advice
